story_title: Enhance and Version Receipt Content Ingestion API

requirements.text: Endpoint accepts fully generated receipt HTML from Trilogy without receipt variables, associates it with property, player, receipt and module identifiers, and rejects missing/invalid HTML with the standard validation response.

requirements.source: [Work Item AC] AC2; Description 'Required request data'
requirements.text: Request supports all fields required to store/display/list/deliver/update the receipt; required fields validated before acceptance; each Receipt ID identifies one receipt; multi-receipt offers supply one Receipt ID per receipt.

Request identifies issuance type (Digital | Printed); both share common identification/lifecycle fields; type is passed to storage and receipt-list processing; printed never classified as digitally delivered.

Printed receipt HTML + metadata accepted (including deliveryMethod None), handed to Loyalty Cloud storage, and does not automatically trigger email or SMS; visible in receipt list only under Technical Setting 'All Receipts'.
Digital receipt can request Email, SMS, Both or None; requested delivery method is passed to downstream notification processing.
Request supports receipt status Issued/Redeemed/Voided, status transaction date and expiration date; invalid statuses or dates are rejected.
Existing supported promotion-receipt integrations keep working; incompatible changes require a new API version; callers are not forced onto an incompatible contract.
Request identifies the source Trilogy module; no Venetian-specific processing; supports OfferMaker, legacy promotions and other enabled modules; participation controlled by enablement configuration.
Valid request handed to #1365562 storage; approved success response only after acceptance; no success when validation fails; failures carry correlation information.

requirements.source: Wiki: Receipt Content Ingestion & Status Update API
requirements.text: Route /{siteId}/api/v1/player/receipt (POST) with required headers x-evri-meta and x-evri-tenantid; documented responses 200, TGO-CNT014 Invalid Tenant, TGO-CNT027 Invalid Meta, TGO-CNT035 Receipt already exists, TGO-CNT040 transaction date after expiration, TGO-CNT034 missing required fields.

Requests must be authenticated (success observed without Signature); x-evri-meta format must be confirmed ('PlayerId;' vs 'PlayerId;ModuleIdentifier;ModuleRecordIdentifier'); meta without ';' returns invalid meta; Invalid Tenant and Invalid Meta must return distinct error codes.

requirements.source: Wiki: Receipt Content Ingestion & Status Update API (shared route)
requirements.text: Ingestion and status update (#1445170) share POST /{siteId}/api/v1/player/receipt; an ingestion request must never be processed as a status update and vice versa.
This item does not send notifications and does not return the player's receipt list; storage (#1365562), notifications (#1349857) and list (#1445171) consume the accepted data.

Ingestion is reliable under concurrency/retries and dependency failures, performs acceptably at Trilogy volumes, and logs accepted/rejected requests with correlation info without leaking sensitive content.
End-to-end: a Trilogy/OfferMaker receipt generated at the kiosk (digital or printed) is ingested into Connector and becomes available to downstream storage/list services.

business_rules: BR-1: Trilogy sends fully generated, translated receipt HTML; Connector never constructs HTML or needs receipt variables (AC1).
BR-2: One Receipt ID = one receipt; an offer producing N receipts sends N distinct Receipt IDs (AC2).
BR-3: A Receipt ID that already exists is rejected with TGO-CNT035 (Wiki).
BR-4: issuanceType is Digital or Printed; a Printed receipt is never treated as digitally delivered (AC3).
BR-5: Printed receipts may use deliveryMethod None and never auto-trigger email/SMS (AC4).
BR-6: deliveryMethod is Email, SMS, Both or None and is passed to notification processing (AC5).
BR-7: receiptStatus is Issued, Redeemed or Voided; transactionDate must not be after expirationDate (AC6, Wiki TGO-CNT040).
BR-8: Printed receipts are returned by the receipt-list API only when the property's Technical Setting is 'All Receipts' (Description).
BR-9: Module participation is controlled by enablement configuration; no property-specific (Venetian) logic (AC8).
BR-10: Success is returned only after the receipt is accepted for storage; validation failures never return success (AC9).
functional_requirements: Authenticated POST /{siteId}/api/v1/player/receipt with x-evri-tenantid and x-evri-meta headers.
Required-field validation (receiptIdentifier, moduleIdentifier, templateName, receiptHtml, issuanceType, deliveryMethod, receiptStatus, transactionDate, expirationDate) -> TGO-CNT034.
Enumerated value validation for issuanceType, deliveryMethod, receiptStatus.
Date validation and transactionDate <= expirationDate rule.
Hand-off of accepted receipt (HTML + metadata + issuance type + delivery method) to storage #1365562.
Backward compatibility / API versioning of the existing receipt/Distribute Voucher integration.
non_functional_requirements: Security: tenant/meta/signature authentication, tenant and player isolation, injection resistance, no sensitive data in errors/logs.
Reliability/Recovery: no false success, retry-safe (duplicate retries do not create a second receipt), concurrency-safe.
Performance: sustained ingestion throughput and large-HTML payloads (SLA and max size not specified).
Supportability: correlation information on failures; auditable request outcomes.
dependencies: #1365562 Store Player Receipt Content and Metadata (persists receipt, creates short Receipt URL).
#1349857 Prepare and Deliver Digital Receipt Notifications (consumes deliveryMethod).
#1445171 Expose Player Receipt List API (consumes issuance type, status, metadata; Technical Setting Digital Only / All Receipts).
#1445170 Receipt Status Update (shares the same route).
#1470255 Post Redeem Offer - Ingest Player Receipt to TCS (Trilogy caller).
Module enablement configuration; Content Service error-code catalogue (Wiki 169844).
constraints: Single route /{siteId}/api/v1/player/receipt, v1, POST, shared with status update.
Player identity is carried by x-evri-meta; property by {siteId} and x-evri-tenantid (no playerId/propertyId in the documented body).
This item does not persist directly, send notifications, or return the receipt list (per AC boundaries).
assumptions: All documented body fields except description are required (wiki sample shows description as "").
Enum values are case-sensitive as documented: Digital/Printed, Email/SMS/Both/None, Issued/Redeemed/Voided.
transactionDate equal to expirationDate is accepted; only strictly-after returns TGO-CNT040 (same as #1445170 baseline).
Validation errors not listed in the wiki (invalid enum, invalid HTML, invalid date format) return 400 in the standard Connector error format; the exact code is to be confirmed.
x-evri-meta 'PlayerId;' is the currently implemented format pending Dev confirmation (Comment #13585124).
Receipt ID uniqueness scope is per tenant/site (to be confirmed).

test_conditions.text: Full receipt HTML accepted, stored verbatim and associated with site, player, receipt and module identifiers.
Missing, empty, invalid or oversized receipt HTML rejected with the standard validation response.
Required metadata validated before acceptance; no partial records on failure.
Receipt ID uniqueness and one-ID-per-receipt for multi-receipt offers.
Field type, length and extra-field boundaries.
Issuance type Digital/Printed accepted, stored and propagated; invalid values rejected.
Printed receipt never classified as digital; list visibility follows Technical Setting.
Printed receipt with deliveryMethod None accepted, stored, and no email/SMS triggered.
Delivery methods Email/SMS/Both/None accepted and propagated; invalid values rejected.
Status values Issued/Redeemed/Voided accepted; invalid values rejected.
Transaction/expiration date validity, precision, timezone and ordering (TGO-CNT040).
Existing promotion-receipt integrations unaffected; versioning rules honoured.
Module identification, module enablement and property-agnostic processing.
Hand-off to storage; success only after acceptance; no false success; correlation info on failure.
Tenant/meta headers, site scoping and documented error codes honoured.
Signature authentication enforced; meta format variants; distinct tenant vs meta errors.
Shared route never confuses ingestion with status update.
Ingestion itself sends no notification and returns no receipt list.
Concurrency, retry, dependency outage, throughput and logging behaviour.
Kiosk redemption in Trilogy results in a stored, listable receipt in Loyalty Cloud.
